status.sendFailed: Your message was not sent. Try again.

notice.heading: Before you start
notice.body: Sample notice: this conversation is kept for one day after its last message and is used to answer your questions. Replace this text with the deployment's own privacy notice.

paused.title: The assistant is paused
paused.body: The assistant is not taking new conversations right now. Please come back later.

rate_limited.title: Too many conversations started
rate_limited.body: Too many conversations were started from your network. Try again in {{seconds}} seconds.

captcha_failed.title: The check did not pass
captcha_failed.body: We could not confirm you are a person. Try the check again.

unavailable.title: The assistant is unavailable
unavailable.body: Something the assistant depends on is not answering. Try again in a few minutes.

network.title: No connection
network.body: The assistant could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.

invalid_request.title: The conversation could not start
invalid_request.body: Reload the page and try again.

replayed.title: This conversation was opened elsewhere
replayed.body: It continues in the other window. Reload to start a new conversation here.

revoked.title: This conversation was opened elsewhere
revoked.body: It continues in the other window. Reload to start a new conversation here.

expired.title: This conversation has ended
expired.body: Reload to start a new conversation.

ended.title: This conversation has ended
ended.body: Reload to start a new conversation.

not_provisioned.title: You are not set up for the assistant
not_provisioned.body: Ask your administrator to give you access.

refused.title: The assistant could not open
refused.body: Open it from a record, or ask your administrator.

widget.waitingForHost: Waiting for your sign-in from the page
widget.noGuestStart: This assistant opens inside an application that signs you in.

carry.label: Continue from your own account
carry.signInHint: New here? Signing in for the first time makes this conversation part of your account.

register.title: Leave your details
register.body: We will email you a sign-in link. Signing in from it continues this conversation in your account.
register.name: Name
register.sent: We emailed a sign-in link to {{email}}. Sign in from it and this conversation continues in your account.
register.awaiting: Thank you. Once your details are reviewed, we will email a sign-in link to {{email}}.

refused.invalid: Add your name and an email address to continue.
refused.claimed: This conversation was already carried into an account.
refused.refused: Your details could not be saved from here. Reload the page and try again.
refused.unavailable: Your details could not be saved right now. Try again in a few minutes.
refused.unsent: Your details are saved, and the email could not be sent. Send them again to get your link.
refused.network: No connection. Check your connection and try again.

continued.title: Continue in the new tab
continued.body: Sign in there and this conversation continues in your account. If no tab opened, open the sign-in page below.

invitation.heading: {{inviter}} invited you to "{{conversation}}"
invitation.signInExplained: Sign in, or create an account, to join. The invitation can be used once.
invitation.linkExplained: You join as a guest in this one conversation, for {{minutes}} minutes, without signing in. The invitation can be used once.
invitation.banner: You are joined as a guest to this conversation only, for a short while.

redeemed.title: This invitation was already used
redeemed.body: An invitation can be used once. Ask {{inviter}} for a new one.

redeemed_elsewhere.title: This invitation was already used
redeemed_elsewhere.body: Somebody joined with this link already. Ask {{inviter}} for a new invitation.

revoked.title: This invitation was withdrawn
revoked.body: It can no longer be used. Ask {{inviter}} if you still need to join.

wrong_account.title: This invitation is for a new account
wrong_account.body: You are signed in with an account that already exists. Ask {{inviter}} to add that account to the conversation, or sign out and continue with a new one.

wrong_mode.title: This invitation cannot be opened here

ended.title: Your visit has ended
ended.body: A guest visit lasts a short while. Ask {{inviter}} for a new invitation to join again.

unknown.title: This link is not recognized
unknown.body: Open the link exactly as it arrived, or ask the person who invited you for a new one.

paused.title: Invitations are paused
paused.body: Joining by link is paused right now. Please come back later.

rate_limited.title: Too many attempts
rate_limited.body: Too many invitations were opened from your network. Try again in {{seconds}} seconds.

captcha_failed.title: The check did not pass
captcha_failed.body: We could not confirm you are a person. Reload the page and try again.

unavailable.title: The invitation could not be opened
unavailable.body: Something it depends on is not answering. Try again in a few minutes.

network.title: No connection
network.body: The invitation could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
